items.q: Then I worked sometimes with... before I went with Mutt (it wasn't a steady job, though), Leon René

ctx.x: Yes. But I had came here in '26. But I didn't go to work with Mutt then. Because we had played around here... We had a fairly big band. Then I worked sometimes with... before I went with Mutt (it wasn't a steady job, though), Leon René, that wrote "When The Swallows Came Back To Capistrano" and...
